en.title: Combinatorics: Permutations and Combinations Explained
en.description: A well-shuffled deck is almost surely in an order no one has ever seen. Shuffle it yourself and watch permutations and combinations explode.
en.og_alt: Combinatorics: has anyone ever seen this exact order of a deck of cards?
